capabilities: , Edit cells directly in reading view
Add, insert, duplicate, clear, and delete rows or columns
Resize column widths by dragging dividers
Merge and split cells from selection
Apply colors to cells, rows, and columns
disambiguation: Not a Notion clone; it is a Markdown-based table editor.
extras: The plugin does not make network requests, collect analytics, or require an account.
problem: Standard Markdown tables lack rich editing features, visual manipulation, and easy in-note editing capabilities.
summary: A plugin that allows users to create and edit Notion-style tables directly within Obsidian Markdown notes, offering rich editing features.
